title: Lavender Scented
description: Bringing new spice to vanilla Minecraft. Heavily modded, but keeping the feel and spirit of vanilla.
body:
# Lavender Scented
Lavender Scented is a **Fabric** pack for **1.21.10**, meant to expand upon the existing mechanics in vanilla, add some new vanilla-aligned things, and introduce a lot of quality-of-life mechanics. The content of the pack is very broad, there are bits of industry, redstone, weapons, magic, mobs, exploration, food, and building blocks - all added in a way I feel is vanilla-friendly. There are some classics here, but most mods are little things that have their own small assortment of changes and additions.

While I don't think I will be adding more to this pack, I will do my best to keep it updated. I will also not be porting it to any other loader or versions.

Let me know if you encounter bugs, I'll do my best to rectify them.
